description: Create a complete BSH extension package skeleton at an absolute path: manifest 2.0, tool descriptors, command, prompt, scoped context, panel, skill, configuration schema and a dependency-free test that passes. Use this instead of writing a manifest by hand.

path.description: Absolute directory to create or fill.

id.description: Reverse-domain extension id, for example com.example.toolkit.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id's last segment.

runtime.description: declarative ships pure tool bodies; process ships server.py.

author.description: Author string for the manifest and LICENSE.

license.description: SPDX license id; defaults to MIT.
